Our technology is uniquely capable of being scaled to 10's of millions of tests of days using semiconductor fab processes, a scale of testing necessary to better inform public health officials and policymakers and enable contact tracing at scale.

PreDxion Bio's origins are in critical care: our original technology is a rapid, near real-time cytokine and biomarker detection platform to monitor the immune response of critically-ill patients. This technology leverages a novel sensor platform we spun out of the University of Michigan. PreDxion Bio has received FDA Breakthrough Device designation and partnered with top pharmcos to monitor the immune response following CAR-T therapy and predict the development of cytokine release syndrome and neurological AEs, and for use in guiding precision medicine approaches in critical care.

launches.title: 💉 🩸SiPhox Health GLP Monitoring
launches.tagline: At-Home Blood Testing Built for GLP Therapy
launches.body:
**TL;DR: We've launched the SiPhox Health GLP Monitoring Panel: at-home blood testing and body composition tracking built specifically for people on GLP-based therapy (Ozempic, Zepbound, Retatrutide, etc.).**

✅ 40+ lab markers covering metabolism, lipids, liver, kidney, thyroid, hormones, and nutrition

✅ Painless upper arm patch at-home collection — no lab visits, no appointments, no finger pricks

✅ In-app body-composition scanner to track fat loss vs. muscle preservation

✅ GLP Tolerance Score — built from your labs, body comp, and symptom check-ins

✅ Symptom check-ins for fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, GI issues, and muscle loss

✅ Wearable integration — Apple Health, Oura, Whoop, Dexcom, Libre, etc.

✅ Upload third-party labs (Quest, Labcorp, etc.) for a complete picture in one dashboard

✅ $199 — HSA/FSA eligible

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102471&key=user_uploads/520037/2235ba82-46fe-42ad-a38b-c5fb7f65c2cd)

### 🔨 Why We Built This

# We're Getting Into the GLP Game — But Not With a Me-Too Product

30 million Americans are currently on GLP drugs. That number is going up. Access is getting easier, prices are falling, and the longevity research on low-dose GLP therapy is compelling enough that it's not hard to imagine most adults cycling on and off these medications eventually, not just for weight loss, but for metabolic health and lifespan.

There are plenty of places to buy Ozempic, but the monitoring and optimization infrastructure is not there yet. The biology of GLP therapy is more complicated than the weight loss headline suggests:

🚫 **Muscle loss is hidden by the scale.** Fast weight loss often means lean mass loss, not just fat. Standard weight tracking can't tell the difference.

🚫 **Side effects are downstream signals.** Fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, and constipation aren't random — they're often markers of caloric under-fueling, nutrient depletion, or dehydration pressure that bloodwork would catch early.

🚫 **Prescribers don't monitor the full picture.** Most GLP patients get minimal follow-up labs, if any. HbA1c, ApoB, ferritin, B12, testosterone, thyroid — none of these are standard-of-care during treatment.

🚫 **Weight alone is a bad success metric.** Losing 24 lbs while losing 6 lbs of muscle and depleting your ferritin is not the same as losing 24 lbs of fat.

# The Solution: A Monitoring Loop Built for GLP Therapy

We've served 50,000+ users with at-home blood testing. GLP users are a distinct population with distinct needs, so we built a product specifically for them. The SiPhox GLP Monitoring Panel connects labs, body composition, and symptom tracking into one continuous loop so you can see what the drug is actually doing to your biology and course-correct before small problems become bigger ones.

---

### 💡 What You Get

**✅ 40+ Lab Markers — GLP-Specific Panel**

Not a generic wellness panel. Built around the markers that matter when appetite, weight, hydration, and body composition are actively changing:

* **Metabolism:** HbA1c, eAG, C-Peptide
* **Lipids & heart:** ApoB, LDL, HDL, Triglycerides, hsCRP
* **Liver:** ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin, albumin
* **Kidney & hydration:** BUN, creatinine, eGFR, BUN:Cr ratio
* **Thyroid:** TSH, Free T4
* **Hormones:** Testosterone (total + free + %), SHBG, cortisol
* **Nutrition:** Vitamin D, B12, folate, ferritin, iron studies (Iron, UIBC, TIBC, Iron Saturation), total protein

**✅ Painless At-Home Collection**

Collected via our Easydraw arm patch, no venous draw, no finger prick, no lab visit. Mail it back, and the results appear in your dashboard.

**✅ Body-Composition Scanning**

In-app scanner tracks fat loss vs. lean mass preservation between tests.

**✅ GLP Tolerance Score**

A composite score built from labs, body comp, and symptom check-ins. Tracks how well your body is handling therapy at each stage: baseline → titration → maintenance.

**✅ Symptom & Side-Effect Tracking**

Track fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, GI issues, and muscle soreness between tests. Connects subjective experience to objective lab data.

**✅ Detailed Analysis & Personalized Insights**

Interpret what's moving in the right direction, what deserves a conversation with your prescriber, and what to adjust in diet, training, or supplementation built around your specific results.

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

---

---

### 📈 Why Now?

GLP drugs are the fastest-growing drug class in history. Next-gen peptides like retatrutide, orforglipron, cagrilintide are coming. The longevity use case is expanding the addressable population well beyond obesity treatment. And monitoring has not kept pace with any of it.

Most patients are flying blind. Prescribers don't have the bandwidth for individualized follow-up. Labs are ordered inconsistently, if at all. No one is connecting weight, body composition, symptoms, and biomarkers in a single continuous view.

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### 🏢 For Businesses: White-Label the GLP Monitoring

Running a GLP prescribing platform, a metabolic health clinic, a wellness app, or a supplement brand with a GLP-adjacent audience? You can white-label or co-brand the entire monitoring program.

**What the partner program gives you:**

✅ White-label or co-branded kit and dashboard under your brand

✅ Full panel access + API integration for embedding results in your own product

✅ Partner dashboard to track your clients' health journeys and customize next steps with real biomarker data

✅ Pre/post protocol testing to prove efficacy and reduce churn

✅ CLIA/CAP-accredited lab processing — same quality as traditional venous draws

✅ Account management, biomarker interpretation training, and marketing support

Patients are 3x more likely to stay engaged with a health program backed by real biomarker data.

🔗 **Partner inquiry:** [siphoxhealth.com/partner](https://siphoxhealth.com/partner)

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

---

### 🤝 For Health Coaches: Refer and Earn

If you work with people on GLP therapy as a health coach, personal trainer, or content creator, our affiliate program is built for you.

No cost to join. No hidden fees. Your referrals get a better monitoring product and better outcomes; you get a meaningful revenue stream.

🔗 **Join the affiliate program:** [siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program](https://siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program)

---

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### About SiPhox Health

SiPhox Health, backed by Khosla Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator, is a full-stack home blood testing company founded at MIT. We've tested 1M+ biomarkers across 50,000+ users. Our long-term mission is SiPhox Home — a silicon photonic chip that delivers instant blood test results from home. The GLP Monitoring Panel runs on our existing CLIA/CAP-accredited lab infrastructure and Easydraw arm collection patch.

launches.title: Sai: Cursor for Lab Test Results
launches.tagline: Your free lab test and health optimization copilot
launches.body:
**TLDR:**

1. SiPhox, already the best option for home blood testing, is launching Sai, an AI lab test analyzer that lives directly in the SiPhox dashboard, just like the Cursor chat lives inside the IDE.
2. You can use it with your SiPhox results or upload your own PDFs/screenshots of lab tests, they will be automatically parsed and added to the dashboard for discussion with Sai.
3. Link here to try for free: https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai

> “AI will cure all diseases in the next 10 years.” – Demis Hassabis, CEO of DeepMind (CBS 60 Minutes)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90232&key=user_uploads/520037/884209a7-485e-4a4f-8533-9904a6d38f8f)

Big claim. Maybe _too_ big.

Something more practical: AI + friction-free diagnostics can wipe out **a significant portion of preventable disease** if we give people the right tools.

That’s exactly what we’re shipping an early version of **today**.

---

### **What’s new**

# 1. **Cursor-style Copilot for Your Labs (Beta)**

Upload any lab report—PDF, photo, whatever—and **Sai**, our GPT-powered assistant, appears as a cursor-style sidebar in your dashboard.

Ask it anything:

* “Why is my ApoB high if my LDL looks fine?”
* “Show me habits that would drop my Trig/HDL under 2.”
* “Review my last several years of test data to see if I might be developing perimenopause.”
* “Generate a doctor-ready summary of my results.”

Or **highlight any section** in your dashboard and click _Ask Sai_

https://youtu.be/B7PZ3QvIEuI

# 2. **Zero-friction At-Home Blood Testing**

* Upper-arm collector (comfortable, collects the sample painlessly in a few minutes)
* Industry-leading, up to **50 biomarkers** in a single kit
* Overnight return shipping to lab for fast results.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90232&key=user_uploads/520037/c7d623a3-5648-489a-a0db-2d8b4b0e55d1)


# 3. **Integrated Expert Review**

Every report is reviewed by health experts. Insights come from a proprietary database developed by SiPhox experts and clinical advisors based on years of longitudinal testing by thousands of users. You still get human nuance + the flexibility of discussing your results with Sai.

# 4. **Free Biological-Age & Heart-Age Scores**

Because a comprehensive dashboard is nice, but **north-star metrics** make it easier to take action and track progress. We built these scores using proprietary models based on public datasets and years of SiPhox user data.

# 5. **Open Uploads**

Not ready to buy a kit? Start by dumping old Quest/Labcorp PDFs into the dashboard for **free**. We’ve had this feature available for a few months now, and uploads are growing exponentially.

---

### **One More Thing 🫀**

# **Heart & Metabolic Program** (launched quietly six months ago, now public)

* **Most complete at-home panel** for cardiometabolic risk (advanced lipids + insulin resistance markers).
* **Phenotype scoring** that fuses glucose-metabolism and lipid data
* American Heart Association risk score and SiPhox **Heart-Age** score so you (and your doctor) can see your heart health status at a glance.
* Access to titrated **lipid-lowering medications** when needed via telemedicine
* Full Sai access, of course.

---

### **Why We’re Doing This**

* **Doctors are time-constrained**. They glance at your test results and say “looks normal” even though “normal” ranges are based on lack of active disease, not disease prevention
* **Patients are guessing**. Reddit threads and WebMD are too generic
* **AI is finally good enough** to translate raw biomarker data into clear, day-to-day actions.
* **Existing doctor-AI tools** are focused on symptom analysis and diagnosis, not on labs and long-term disease prevention
* **60% of Americans have a chronic disease.** We want to help these people manage or even reverse their conditions and help the other 40% stay healthy long into old age.

### **“There’s a new AI agent/chatbot launching every day. Why does the world need another one?”**

1. It’s 100% true that anyone can upload their lab results to ChatGPT or another LLM interface and have a passable conversation about them. Based on our real-world experience with the SiPhox user-base, having a single health dashboard where all of your health data lives makes all the difference. **It’s the same reason Cursor is more useful for coding than ChatGPT…** the assistant in the IDE and has all the necessary context to collaborate with the user. This is something we wanted to experiment with (and we are looking to get as much feedback as possible on the UI).
2. ChatGPT and other chatbots do great on generic medical exams but just like a typical primary care physician, they are less trained to handle health optimization and advanced bloodwork. Selecting “deep research” gives better results, but the output still requires an expert to confirm.
3. SiPhox customized Sai using years of experience repeatedly testing, and coaching tens of thousands of users. This kind of dataset of frequent, comprehensive testing and coaching doesn’t exist publicly (or privately, as far as we know) for LLMs to train on.
4. We are not an AI company building in a vacuum; we are a hardware and clinical product company building, integrating AI to serve the needs of active users who partner with us every day to improve their health.

**Transparently, we are not convinced that this form factor (a chatbot)** is the final iteration, but given the state of AI today (latency vs. accuracy and intelligence tradeoffs), this is where we are starting.

---

### [TALK TO SAI](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai)

1. **Don’t forget to upload past labs** → your data and trends are analyzed and displayed in a clear dashboard with the Sai sidebar\_: [https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai%5C)
2. **Sign up for a home blood test kit subscription** → 20 % off for the YC community with code [LAUNCHYC20](https://siphoxhealth.com/?discount=LAUNCHYC20)
3. Are you a business, healthtech startup, clinic, physician or coach? You can utilize all of these features in SiPhox Enterprise, co-branded or white-labeled: https://siphoxhealth.com/partner

---

Ten years to cure all diseases is optimistic, but giving everyone a personal lab analyst today is how we start making progress.

See you in the dashboard,

The SiPhox Health team

\_________________________________________________________________\_

### **How is my data handled?**

SiPhox does not sell or share your personal data. SiPhox maintains compliance with industry grade security and best data privacy standards.

\_________________________________________________________________\_

### **The disclaimer:**

Sai is an AI-powered assistant (Beta) developed by SiPhox to provide general informational and educational responses based on its training data. Like other AI models (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini), Sai may occasionally generate incomplete, outdated, or inaccurate information. We are actively working to improve its performance and reliability.

Sai does **not** provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it is **not** a substitute for professional medical guidance. The use of Sai does **not** create a doctor-patient relationship. Any health-related content generated by Sai should not be acted upon without first consulting a qualified healthcare provider.

SiPhox disclaims any liability for decisions made based on information provided by Sai. By using Sai, you acknowledge and agree to these limitations and to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

launches.title: 🩸 SiPhox Health Ultimate Program – Comprehensive & Painless At-Home Blood Testing
launches.body:
### **TL;DR: We’ve launched the SiPhox Health Ultimate Program, a next-generation at-home blood testing and health tracking platform.**

✅ 50+ biomarkers tracked painlessly from home

✅ No venous draws, fingerpricks, traveling, appointments, or waiting rooms. Collect from home with the painless Easydraw arm collector device

✅ 100+ total biomarkers when paired with yearly primary care lab result

✅ Upload all your past lab tests (any lab) to track everything in one dashboard

✅ AI-powered body fat % estimation using your phone camera (validated against DEXA scan)

✅ Seamless integration with wearables & glucose monitors

✅ Expert-driven, actionable, personalized insights

✅ $498/year – less than $42/month for full health tracking — 50+ biomarker home tests twice per year

🔗 **Try it now:** [siphoxhealth.com/ultimate-program](https://siphoxhealth.com/ultimate-program?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=ultimate-launch)

---

### **🔨 Why We Built This**

# **The Problem: Blood Testing Is Stuck in the Past**

We live in a world where wearables track heart rate, sleep, and glucose 24/7, yet blood testing—the most critical health data source—is still:

🚫 **Infrequent** – Most people only test once per year at a doctor's visit.

🚫 **Incomplete** – Many key biomarkers are not tested until symptoms appear.

🚫 **Inconvenient** – Booking an appointment, traveling to a lab, and waiting weeks for results is a hassle.

🚫 **Painful** – Finger pricks and venous blood draws deter regular tracking.

🚫 **Fragmented** – No easy way to combine biomarker data with wearables or look at trends in past blood test data.

Meanwhile, people want more and better **insights into their health**, whether for **longevity, athletic performance, metabolic health, hormonal balance, chronic disease prevention, or chronic disease management.**

# **The Solution: Convenient Biomarker Tracking + Personalized Health Insights**

🔬 We spent the last **2.5 years** **experimenting** with at-home blood test kit offerings to solve this problem and **tested tens of thousands of people**.

With the **SiPhox Health Ultimate Program**, we brought blood biomarker tracking, painless home sample collection, advanced biomarkers, personalized insights, body composition, and wearable integration into one seamless platform—so you can take control of your health without paperwork, clinics, finger pricks, or expensive lab tests.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/8ea35ddb-b0ed-49ad-8fe6-1a39abf649eb)

### **💡 What did we learn since our last launch**

We launched our service in beta September of 2022 🚀

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/18182bcb-e16e-4037-8d76-d14d009e28a0)

We’ve since served **10s of thousands** of users. Here are our **learnings**:

1. More biomarkers = Better insights
   * Larger panels are more likely to uncover issues before they become serious
   * Users can handle (and often crave) more health data as long as it’s placed in proper context and made easy to understand
   * Biomarkers like ApoB, Ferritin, C-Peptide, Testosterone and others that are normally not tested without symptoms can often reveal early warning signs that can be reversed with low-effort interventions
2. Finger pricks don't work for everybody. Some people don’t mind them at all but they deter many from maintaining regular testing.
3. Comprehensive home blood testing can make a big difference in people’s lives. A few examples below in the words of our users:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/b9dce2a7-78a1-46d5-ba3e-13ed5594e215)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/07fcc565-3131-435d-b56b-ded73ebbdab4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/d9745e3b-0cbf-4868-bd20-5aeb61d19065)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vHC_5CRaMN0>

### **💡 What You Get**

✅ **At-Home Blood Testing – No Finger Pricks Required**

We've launched **Easydraw**, a **painless upper-arm blood collection patch** that allows you to test **50+ biomarkers** from home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/b03d31fb-e658-4d1c-ae36-4316da2d42b0)

✅ **100+ Biomarkers with Your Annual Primary Care Lab Results**

Easily **upload previous blood test results** from any lab (e.g., Quest, Labcorp) to **build the most complete biomarker dataset possible.** A typical annual wellness blood test contains a Complete Blood Count, Complete Metabolic Panel, and a Urine test. Add these to the SiPhox panel for a more complete picture of your health.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/78cf4613-c1de-434f-b38b-a62eadd72733)

✅ **AI-Powered Body Fat % Estimation**

Using just your phone camera, our app **analyzes body composition with AI**—giving you an accurate **body fat % estimate validated against Dexascan**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/36289b67-aab1-4b69-946d-b515743689c8)

✅ **Wearable Integration + Continuous Health Tracking**

Syncs seamlessly with **Apple Health, Oura, Whoop, Abbot Libre, Dexcom, and more** to combine biomarker testing with **sleep, activity, HRV, and glucose data.**

✅ **Expert-driven, actionable, personalized insights and action plans**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87455&key=user_uploads/520037/b26827e0-45ee-41ac-a694-a9f24fd42df5)

**✅ Scientists**

Our team is made up of experts, Ph.D.s, MDs, and engineers, who are passionate about blood testing and health optimization. SiPhox is the only direct-to-consumer (DTC) home blood testing company developing its own hardware.

**✅ More value for your money**

We avoid costly partnerships with celebrities and focus on shipping new features as our main driver of growth.

### **📈 Why Now?**

---

6 out of 10 Americans have at least one chronic disease. Getting and staying healthy is more of a priority than ever before. Wearables, CGMs, and health tracking are becoming mainstream, but **blood testing is stuck in the past**—it’s inconvenient, painful, and limited to annual checkups.

SiPhox Health bridges the gap, combining **at-home biomarker testing** with a **seamless, full-featured health dashboard.**

---

🩸 **Sign up today:** [siphoxhealth.com/ultimate-program](https://siphoxhealth.com/ultimate-program?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=ultimate-launch)

---

### 🔗 **About SiPhox Health**

---

SiPhox Health, backed by Khosla Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator, is a full-stack home blood testing company currently offering consumers and businesses mail-in test kits to conveniently measure a broad range of biomarkers. Founded at MIT, our mission is to commercialize SiPhox Home—a silicon photonic chip-based device that delivers instant blood test results at home, making biomarker testing easier, smarter, and more accessible than ever.

## **TL; DR:**

Trying to understand your blood test results shouldn't be a confusing or frustrating experience. At SiPhox Health, we simplify your lab results, offering clear insights into your health, actionable steps to improve it, and affordable at-home tests to track your progress. Say goodbye to cluttered, overwhelming reports, and hello to a healthier, more informed you.

**🔗Link to try it out:** <https://siphoxhealth.com/understand-your-test-results>

## **🚨 The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/b16be89b-06df-4b1c-8919-382ec764ecf1)

**60% of American adults** are living with at least one chronic illness, and **40%** are living with two or more. Regular blood tests are vital for identifying and managing these conditions, but the traditional reports often add to the confusion.

Instead of offering clarity, you're met with pages of numbers, confusing medical jargon, and reference ranges that merely tell you if you’re “in” or “out”. If you're lucky enough to discuss the results with your doctor, you might gain some clarity and a prescription, but you’re unlikely to fully understand the status of your body, and feel like you have a clear plan to improve your health.

What's more, as long as your results aren't drastically abnormal, you might not receive any feedback from your doctor at all. This can lead to the neglect of critical signals—issues that may only become apparent when they escalate, often surfacing only a year later in your next annual blood test.

## 💡 **The SiPhox Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/a84c1e65-96d2-494d-aab4-d8d097d3908f)

Check out a demo of the dashboard here: <https://app.siphoxhealth.com/reports/demo-siphox-dashboard>

We’ve developed a platform that turns your blood test results into actionable insights, empowering you to understand your body, make informed changes to improve your health and track your progress over time.

1. Understand your body
   * Simple explanations for each test, and insights to help you understand what your result for that test means.
2. Make changes.
   * Personalized diet, lifestyle, and supplement recommendations based on your blood test results and health goals. Our bodies are unique, complex systems, for which general recommendations will not suffice. Your action plan will be made custom for you.
3. Track progress.
   * How do you know if the changes have been effective? Take another blood test with a SiPhox at-home testing kit. SiPhox offers the most comprehensive and inexpensive at-home blood test kit on the market.
   * Visualize how your biomarkers are trending on simple, intuitive graphs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/a67fa2bf-4ccc-453f-8ede-b5db1b40f41e)

## **How did we develop our algorithms:**

We run a mail-in blood testing subscription service ([$165 for quarterly testing](https://siphoxhealth.com)) that enables users to test 17 key blood biomarkers from home with a painless self-collected sample. We trained an AI algorithm on the massive amount of biomarker data we’ve collected over the years, coupled with all the insights our clinical team delivered to our subscribers.

## **How it works:**

1. **Upload Your Results:** You can upload blood test results from any doctor or provider by either uploading a file or manually entering them.
2. **Help us understand your goals:** Take a short questionnaire to help us understand your current lifestyle and what your health goals are. For example, you’re currently fairly sedentary and would like to boost your energy and mood.
3. **Receive your Insights:** We use a combination of AI and our experts to generate personalized, actionable insights for you. Within two days of submitting your report, you’ll be able to view these insights in your dashboard.
4. **Take another blood test:** After implementing your health protocols, take another blood test to see how your biomarkers have adapted. Then, you can view the state of each biomarker with intuitive graphs and scores.
5. **For bonus points:** Connect your wearable device to combine sleep, activity, and heart rate data with your blood biomarkers in the same dashboard.

<https://www.loom.com/share/cf58b874538249bc91026d074a38fdde?sid=baaee4a9-710c-4626-ae12-b2361cf94515>

## **⚡️ Real Results, Real Impact:**

With hundreds of thousands of blood biomarker results delivered, SiPhox is already transforming how people understand, track, and improve their health. Whether it's identifying nutritional gaps or optimizing fitness, our users are making data-driven decisions that lead to tangible improvements in their well-being.

Join a growing community of health-seekers by uploading your blood test results today.

## 🤝 **Quick ask**

* [Click here to try it out!](https://siphoxhealth.com/understand-your-test-results)
* If you find the product helpful, share it with your friends, family, and social media followers.
* We welcome feedback on SiPhox’s product and encourage you to suggest new features.

**Talk to us** - Interested in working, learning more, or collaborating? Email [team@siphoxhealth.com](mailto:team@siphoxhealth.com) or visit our [partner](https://my.siphoxhealth.com/pages/partner) and [career](https://my.siphoxhealth.com/pages/careers) pages.

## 🦊**About SiPhox**

[SiPhox](https://www.siphoxhealth.com/) Health, Inc. is a venture-backed startup in Greater Boston that integrates microfluidics, biochemistry, and Silicon Photonics to miniaturize proteomics. It was founded in February 2020. We are building lab-quality blood testing and advanced primary care for the home to help prevent and manage chronic disease.

The SiPhox team has extensive experience translating cutting-edge optical chip technology into mass-produced products used worldwide. It is bringing the same proven approach to the next frontier for integrated photonics. This new frontier is biology.

SiPhox has [raised](https://techcrunch.com/2023/07/19/intel-khosla-27m-siphox-health-at-home-blood-test-healthcare/?guccounter=1) $29M to date and is backed by Y Combinator, Intel Capital, Metaplanet, and Khosla Ventures.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83565&key=user_uploads/520037/83d647ea-a0c1-491c-bd8c-7d9dcb635796)

## **📝Disclaimer:**

This free service is meant for informational and educational purposes only. The reference ranges and insights presented in the SiPhox Health dashboard are meant to improve readability and provide context; however, you should consult with your physician for a more formal interpretation of your results. No communication from SiPhox Health is meant to be or should be taken as medical advice. SiPhox Health is a wellness-only service and is not designed to diagnose, prevent, or treat any disease. If you are concerned about any of the data in your dashboard, please consult your physician immediately.

launches.title: Amina: The Agentic Protein Engineer
launches.tagline: Design, simulate, and test your proteins 100x faster with our no-code platform for protein engineering!
launches.body:
**👋 Hey YC! We're Abhi and Adam from AminoAnalytica.**

**Amina is the first AI agent for end-to-end protein engineering** – instead of wrestling with hundreds of fragmented tools, scientists can now design protein therapeutics through simple conversation.

## **🎬 Trailer**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n8Pd9BJcbQA

## **🧬 The Problem with Programmable Biology**

The 2024 Nobel Prize for Chemistry went to AlphaFold - proving we can predict and design proteins like software. These biological machines could solve climate change, cure diseases, and manufacture anything we need.

But here's the reality: **hundreds of new computational biology tools launch every week.** Even expert researchers stick to the same old methods they know, missing breakthrough tools that could accelerate their work by months or years.

**Meet Dave, your friendly neighborhood protein engineer** 👨‍🔬

Dave is designing a cancer therapeutic, but his current workflow is broken:

* **Inaccessible tools** → most have no UI, require specific hardware, must be built from source
* **Fragmented ecosystem** → tools don't work together, requiring pages of glue code
* **Constant obsolescence** → by the time he masters one tool, three better ones have launched

The result? **Scientists spend more time debugging code than designing life-saving therapeutics.**

## **🚀 Our Solution**

**What if you could just describe what you want in plain English?**

Instead of wrestling with complex pipelines and staying up-to-date with every new tool, you simply tell Amina what protein you need and why.

**Dave before Amina:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92017&key=user_uploads/1754946/ad201bdd-6ed8-4b33-bb1f-fd8ca58f5262)

**Dave with Amina:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92017&key=user_uploads/1754946/3657d135-74af-4ed9-b261-394f14fe42a5)

## **🔬 What Makes Amina Different**

This isn't just model hosting. Amina is trained on both scientific literature and our proprietary experience from engineering thousands of proteins for customers - it knows which tools to use when, how to chain them together, and how to interpret results. It's like having our entire computational team's expertise distilled into a single agent.

With our no-code interface, 50+ specialized tools work together seamlessly. Amina catches potential issues, suggests optimizations, and explains results in plain English.

## **🎯 Our Vision**

**Our ultimate goal is for Amina to design proteins autonomously** - think JARVIS, but dedicated to discovering breakthrough therapeutics. For now, it's like having an extra bioinformatician on your team that needs less care and attention than your cell cultures.

## **🙏 Our Ask**

**If you work in biotech, pharma, or have an interest in protein engineering** - we'd love your feedback on Amina.

**Try it for free at [aminoanalytica.com](http://aminoanalytica.com)** - no setup required, start designing in 60 seconds.

Need extra credits? Just message us at [support@aminoanalytica.com](mailto:support@aminoanalytica.com)

launches.title: 🧬 AminoAnalytica – Next generation proteins engineered with *protein* language models
launches.tagline: We’re creating the next generation of peptides and enzymes using our proprietary pipeline, powered by protein language models.
launches.body:
Hey everyone – it’s [Abhi Rajendran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirajen/), [Adam Wu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/akhwu/) and [Matteo Peluso](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matteo-peluso-872b85199/)

**Tl;dr**: just look at the pictures ;)

# **💞 The A(mino) Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82706&key=user_uploads/1754946/96f298df-f236-4401-91d5-2ce61024e644)

👨🏾 **Abhi Rajendran** – From Imperial College London to the Mercedes F1 Team, Abhi builds AI tools in data-intensive environments. AminoAnalytica was inspired by his computational bio master’s project and was the top AI x Robotics venture from Imperial in 2024.

👦🏻 **Adam Wu** – With experience in academic and industry wet labs, Adam is now building his own. He has a background in materials science, tissue engineering and biosensing as a Thermo Fisher Scholar from Imperial.

👱🏼‍♂️ **Matteo Peluso** – Bioinformatics PhD from the University of Zurich. His skills in biology, machine learning, and software development tie up everything seamlessly.

👨🏻‍🦱 **Dr. Stefano Angioletti-Uberti** – Senior lecturer at Imperial, specializing in modeling biological and soft matter systems. He ensures models are based on the latest scientific principles.

# **❌ Problem: better proteins are needed to accelerate global innovation**

* Industrial and pharma companies prefer to use enzymes and peptides over harsh chemicals as they are more specific and sustainable.
* However, natural proteins often lack stability, efficiency, or specificity for their desired applications leading to poor performance
* Improving these proteins has been a costly and inefficient 'trial-and-error' process, where biotech companies randomly mutate existing proteins, test them, and repeat until success.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82706&key=user_uploads/1754946/afb4dbcf-6cc7-43e1-915e-609278e798fa)

# **✅ Solution: AminoAnalytica’s protein adaptation platform, powered by PLMs**

* Like how ChatGPT understands human language, our **"protein language models" (PLMs)** understand biology and can optimize proteins for industrial and therapeutic use.
* This allows us to perform in-silico protein property prediction, eliminating the need for thousands of lab tests.
* We’re transforming the traditional ‘trial-and-error’ method into an ultra-high throughput and rational process.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82706&key=user_uploads/1754946/65fb8e1a-d749-4245-adca-a0abc1ad8529)

# **🤝 Any industry working with proteins can benefit from our tech**

Currently, we’re working on:

* **Aquaculture feed** → enzymes for maximizing fish feed nutritional efficiency
* **Pharmaceuticals** → peptide drugs with improved stability and specificity
* **Climate tech** → enzymes for eco-friendly carbon capture
* **Consumer goods** → safer enzymes for everyday products

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82706&key=user_uploads/1754946/30bf87a9-4ee8-49e6-a0ee-7f8dd85bf008)

# **🐡 Get in touch with us!**

* Upvote/share this post with your network and help spread the word!
* If you (or anyone in your network) are as excited as we are about next generation industrial proteins and would like to learn more about what we’re doing, email us here - [founders@aminoanalytica.app](mailto:founders@aminoanalytica.app)
* We’re also looking to expand **our advisory board** in the areas of aquaculture, fish testing, and feed manufacturing!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82706&key=user_uploads/1754946/908a3520-d234-4338-ad05-154aa3515672)
